UPDATE
            email_sync_streams
        SET
            position = $2,
            initial_complete = initial_complete OR $3,
            last_completed_at = CASE WHEN $3 THEN now() ELSE last_completed_at END,
            next_run_at = GREATEST(now() + make_interval(secs => $4), provider_retry_at),
            lease_id = NULL,
            lease_until = NULL
        WHERE
            id = $1
